//BlightSpread: The crop blight's damage (Documentation/Research/HarshWilds/events_stats.md section 5b and its crop blight DECISION): while hw_stat_blight runs, once every HW_BLIGHT_SPREAD_COOLDOWN = 24 ticks it adds Fungal Infection to the planted crops of the place the player stands, and takes Health from the ones already past vanilla's own infection threshold. No vanilla crop, stat or plot definition is edited: the fungus is vanilla's Special4 'Fungal Infection' on each crop card, the health loss is vanilla's Special2 'Health', and the hurt is delivered by the engine's own remote durability edit, ExtraDurabilityModifications, which vanilla Tgr_Pee and Tgr_Poop already run from a self-triggered action. ALL GATES ARE StatChangeTrigger ENTRIES: hw_switch_cropblight {1,1} (the [Threats] CropBlight switch; off, the spread never runs) and hw_stat_blight {1,192} (1 to HW_BLIGHT_TICKS, the timer's whole running range). The one non-stat gate is RequiredCardsOnBoard: a vanilla GardenPlot (f853a0a8ad6c64c4b81eabb8367c0c5c) on the player's board. RepeatOptions 0 (Repeat), OncePerTick, ActionCooldown 24: with the 192 tick timer that is 8 spreads a blight, on ticks 1, 25, 49 and so on. THE SAFETY CONTRACT, the same class of risk as the bandit's theft (hw_tgr_bandit_theft.json): an ExtraDurabilityChange whose card list is empty and has no AffectedTags means EVERY CARD (ExtraDurabilityChange.AppliesToAllCards), so a broken list would damage every card on the board, chests and their contents included. Both changes therefore name an allowlist by UniqueID (GUID hash), never by tag: exactly the 44 vanilla Growing and Mature planted-crop cards (22 families times 2; the 22 Dormant cards are left alone on purpose, and the eight field cards are excluded because their Special4 is Care, not fungus), and Development_Tools/Tests/HarshWilds-Events.Tests.ps1 recomputes that list from the export on every run. HarshWilds/Patcher/BlightSpreadGuard.cs checks at load, on what the game actually resolved, that both changes are exactly this, and on ANY fault empties the action's ExtraDurabilityModifications so a broken build damages nothing (with the list empty the action fails WillHaveAnEffect and never plays). AppliesTo 6 = AllCardsInLocation: the location row of the place the player stands, and with LookInInventories true the cards inside what sits there. A GardenPlot is CT2, which the game places in the location row, and its crops are the contents of its inventory: GraphicsManager.GetCurrentLocationCards adds each location card's CardsInInventory piles when it is asked to count inventories, and a placed Copper Chest was measured to be reached this way in the bandit work. The research draft named AppliesTo 0 (AllCardsOnBoard), which also reaches every planted crop item wherever it sits in the env, including a crop carried in a basket; the location row is narrower, is the value with a measured live precedent, and is exactly where a plot stands. IncludeEquippedCards false, CardChanges 0 (ChangeDurabilities: it never destroys a card), RandomlyAffectedCards 0 (every listed crop, not half: the game floors half of a count, so one crop in the plot would never have been blighted, and it would make the arithmetic below a coin toss). Change 1 adds HW_BLIGHT_FUNGAL = 56 to Special4Change. Change 2 takes HW_BLIGHT_HEALTH = 6 from Special2Change, only from crops whose Fungal Infection is 144 to 288 (RequiredDurabilities Special4Range, the very range vanilla's own 'Fungal Infestation (Health -0.05)' effect on every one of the 44 crops starts at); the engine runs change 1 first and, INFERRED (Unity's StartCoroutine runs a coroutine's first step at once, and ChangeCardDurabilities writes before its first yield; harness check C8), its durability write lands before change 2 reads the crop, so a crop pushed over 144 by this spread is hurt by this spread; if it does not, the health loss simply starts one spread later. NUMBERS, all TUNABLE PLACEHOLDERS, session-inferred and unmeasured against play. The research draft's HW_BLIGHT_FUNGAL = 40 on half the crops cannot work: a crop sheds 24 fungus between spreads, so 40 nets +16, the timer allows only 8 spreads, and the threshold of 144 would be reached once at the very last spread on a crop hit every time, i.e. the blight would do nothing. At 56 on every crop an untreated crop nets +32 per spread and passes 144 at the fourth spread (health is taken on spreads 4 to 8, 30 health in all, plus vanilla's own small effect while the infection lingers). Vanilla's treatment is unchanged and works against it: 'Apply Fungicide' with LQ_Fungicide or LQ_GarlicWater raises the plot's Special2 'Pesticide - Fungi' by 96, and while it reads 1 or more the plot's own 'insecticide' effect (the labels are swapped against the slots in the export) takes 1 more Fungal Infection a tick off every crop; the crops' own 'Care' effect (it needs the plot's Progress at 1 or more, and no vanilla action was found that sets it, so no player text offers it) takes 0.25 more; overwatering adds 1.25. So, with the first application made the moment the blight starts, one fungicide application still lets 2 health hits through, fungicide plus the Care effect lets 1, and two applications let none (a simulation of the arithmetic above, not a play measurement; harness check C8 measures the real numbers). The player text says fungicide, garlic water and not overwatering, and does not promise more. Scope, stated so nobody is surprised: it reaches only the place the player stands, only garden plot crops (no field card, no Herbs and Fungi plant), and a plot the player never visits during the 192 ticks is never blighted.
